findings.claim: The generated-formatter path (GeneratedFormatterCollector) ignores the type's [MessagePackObject]-level security-relevant shape: there is no recursion or depth guard in the generated formatter beyond existing templates, and the collector builds ObjectSerializationInfo with empty constructorParameters for classes. Contractless members of the referenced type are all deserialized through the resolver, so MessagePackSecurity.MaximumObjectGraphDepth (via the existing template's options.Security.DepthStep) still applies. No new bypass was found, but the collector's GetInstanceMembers walks base types without cycle or depth limits on compile-time data; this is a compile-time concern only, so I am not reporting it as a security issue.

receipt_plan.detail: Confirm the FormatterTemplate and StringKeyFormatterTemplate still emit options.Security.DepthStep(ref reader) and reader.Depth-- for IsUserDeclaredFormatter=true output; the diff only changes the class declaration line.
